Donate.title: Make an Offering
Donate.subtitle: Your compassion sustains this space of peace and wisdom. All offerings are received with deep gratitude and mindfulness.
Donate.realTier1Desc: Light a single flame in the sanctuary. Receive 54 lotus petals — one for each chapter of the Dhammapada.
Donate.realTier2Desc: Offer a lotus in full bloom. Receive 333 lotus petals — the number of steps on the sacred path.
Donate.realTier3Desc: Offer a prayer mala. Receive 1,080 lotus petals and have your name eternally etched on the Supporter's Wall.
Donate.lotusTier1Desc: A small offering of presence. Your energy joins the collective field.
Donate.lotusTier2Desc: Ring the virtual bell. Your intention resonates through the temple for all seekers.
Donate.lotusTier3Desc: Illuminate the shrine. Your light supports this sacred space for one moon cycle.
Donate.comingSoon: 🔔 Virtual offering of {count} lotus petals — coming soon!
Donate.lotusModeNote: 🪷 Your lotus petals were received with gratitude. Offering them back to the temple community is a beautiful act of dana — the Buddhist virtue of generosity.
Donate.paypalNote: PayPal payments are processed securely. Your financial data is never stored on our servers. Lotus petals are credited after payment confirmation.
Donate.virtualNote: Virtual lotus offerings support the temple community spirit. They are not financial transactions.
Donate.lotusNotice: ※ Lotus offerings are spiritual gestures to illuminate the sanctuary. To establish an eternal Pillar in the Hall of Supporters, please make your offering via the [Real Offering] tab.
